content: Awgadhaw patidhaygi yawadhan Nowalpa
Awgadhan nungu woenab poeybadhin Nowalpa a nungu garkaz kazipa. Nuy kedha mulaydhin, ‘Koeyma bal matha kazil gasamidhe, lak bangal ngithamun kaziw kazil mura thabi apa goewanu nithamoene.
‘Mura boeradharaw uruyl, a boethal uruyl, a malu uruyl ngithamulngu bangal akan; thana mura ngithamuniya apal.
Ngithamulpa aygudoepa ubipa, matha kedha boeradharaw ayde, ngath mura ngithamulpa kusuman ayde.

Urapun za ngitha bal purthayg, ngidh nanga uruy mathaman ngidh ngaru kulka adhapa manin sobaginga, kalanu ngidh purthan. Madhul nanga kulkalmayl ngath lawnga manin ngithamulngu aygudoengu kedha zoenguz kedha senaw kulka nanga nuy mura igilaw za.
‘Mabaygaw kulka lak kedha igilaw za, ngitha mabaygaw kulka pay yoewdhayg, minguz kedha nuyn Awgadhaw ngoedhalnga aymoedhin.

content.text: Ngadh nanga mabaygaw kulka pay yoewdhan,
mabaygan kuniya lak nungu kulka pay yoewdhan.
nuydh nanga mabaygaw kulka pay yoewdhan
ngath lak kedha kuth poeyban uruypa.

content: ‘Ngitha koeyma bangal kazil mamayine, lak bangal thana mura nithamoene thabi apa goewanu.’
Awgadhaw patidhaygi yangukudu Nowalpa a matha kedha nungu garkaz kazingu
Awgadh lak mulaydhin thanamulpa, Nowa a nungu garkaz kazil kedha,
‘Ina ngath ngaw patidhaygi yawadhan ayimpa ngithamulpa, a ngithamun kaziw kazipa,
a setha ngithamuniya kalmel mi igil uruyl nanga adhapa pagamoeydhin butangu, boeradharaw uruyl a boethal uruyl.

In nubi yadu ngath ngaw patidhaygi yangukudu ayman ngithamuniya mura parunu. Ngay mina ya muliz kedha, ngayapa lak mura igilzapa woeray dudupoeypa lawnga, ngayapa nubi gugu ubidh thoeyayzimayngu lak woerngu idimoeypa lawnga.
Nubi patidhaygi yangukudupa ngaw, ngithamulpa mina yapathoemaypa, ngitha mabaygal a mura igil uruyl,
ngath maku ayman dhudhuwab dapara ziyanu gimanoeka, ngithamulpa ngoenanumaypa ngaw patidhaygi yangukudu ngithamulpa.
Mi thonara nanga ngath dapar ziyal palan, senabi thonara ngath dhudhuwab nanga iman, ngath ngaw patidhaygi yangukudu ngoenanumanin ngithamulpa kedha, ngayapa nubi apa goewapa lak dudupoeypa lawnga.
Dhudhuwab nanga zilamiz ziyaw kuthiya ngitha bangal ngaw yangukudu ngoenanumayparu kuthagi kuykugi yawadhan ngayapa ngithamulpa mura mabaygal a igil zapul nubi gugu ubidh thoeyayzimaya.
Senawbi dhudhuwab nuy bangal maku ngaw yawoedhayzimaypa mura nubi apaw goewaw mabaygoepa a igilzapa.’
Nowa a nungu kazil
Nowan kaziw nelay itha kedha, Sem, Am, a Zapeth. Thana butungu adhapagoemoeydhin. (Am nungu kazil Kananaw doegam mabaygal aymoeydhin.)
In mura mabayg nubi apaw goewanu muynu nanga thanamun kaziw kazingu pawpa kupar palaydhin Nowan thoeri kazingu.
Woerngu kalanu, koeykoeyne apaw lagaw zagethaw mabayg Nowa; nuydh kulay goereypaw apaw lag aymoedhin.
Thana nanga goereypaw koewsal giyasimoeydhin, nuydh umal nguki aymoedhin a wanaydhin. Nuy nanga um walaydhin nuy kasa kupal potowakunu muynu uthuy yoewnadhin.
Nungu kazi Am, Kananalgaw muruyg nuydh nungu thathi imadhin kasa kupal. Nuy uzaraydhin a nungu ukasar tukuypoepa mulaydhin.

Kalanu palay Sem a Zapeth koey sodh madhin, palay kaliya gud paladhin palamuniya a kalal uzarmoedhin muya uthemoemoedhin palamun thathiw potowakuya. Palay nuyn imayginga palay kasa matha woergi thayadhin palamun thathiya, paru matha adhapa nungungu imayle.
Nowa nanga balbayg asidhin nanga nuydh gasamoedhin kedha, nungu kuthay kazin nubepa midh nanga aymoedhin
nuy kedha mulaydhin,

content.text: ngibepa wara mina zapa gasamoeypa lawnga,

content: Nuy Nowa kalanu eso pugaydhin Awgadhoepa kedha,

content.text: nuy waza nginu getha doegamaw mabayg,
Awgadhan bangal nubepa kapu za aymoene,

content: Koey woerngu woeyay kalanu Nowa sizi pawpa lak kuykuthalnga uzaraydhin 350 wathoelnga.
Kurusipa nungu wathoel 950 aymoeydhin nanga nuydh nungu kuth gasamoedhin.
